title: [GMCP 203.015.05] Interoperability and quality: MCP Apps extension and secure interactive UI
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-015-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: GMCP hosts and consumes the stable MCP Apps extension end to end: resources and tool results can declare trusted UI metadata, render in a sandboxed surface, call permitted tools, update state, and degrade to accessible non-visual content. CSP, origin isolation, permissions, accessibility, lifecycle, version negotiation, hostile app content and cross-app data separation pass the official extension suite and browser security tests. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
